## What I Do

I enforce evidence-first execution for non-trivial repository work.

## Read Alongside

- `docs/ai/execution-protocol.md`
- `docs/ai/capabilities/evidence-first-execution/CAPABILITY.md`

## Required Sequence

1. classify task mode
2. check current worktree state
3. protect pre-existing user changes
4. apply minimal patch only
5. verify with relevant evidence
6. report verification classification and risks
